findings.question: How good is he at creating his own shot?
findings.unit: creation-skill score (pull-up, drive, iso, pick-and-roll), league SD units

findings.question: Do teammates shoot threes better when he is on the floor?
findings.unit: teammate 3P% lift, percentage points (career, shrunk)
findings.pool: all career rows with an estimate (1195)
findings.caveat: Real but small: true spread across players is about 0.5 pp per teammate three; most intervals include zero.

findings.question: Do opponents stop attacking the rim when he is on the floor?
findings.unit: opponent rim attempts avoided, league SD units (lineup-adjusted; higher = more deterrence)
